name: application-details-list
title: Details Lists
description: Structured key–value pair displays for presenting record details, account information, and configuration summaries.
useWhen: Displaying the properties of a single record such as a user profile, order detail, or settings summary.
Showing metadata alongside a main content area — dates, authors, statuses, and identifiers.
Rendering structured form output or confirmation screens after submission.
avoidWhen: Displaying many records at once — use a table instead.
All values are numeric and benefit from column alignment — a table with numeric columns is clearer.
The data changes frequently and benefits from real-time updates — consider a stat or live feed component.
responsiveBehavior: Label and value columns stack vertically on small viewports and sit side-by-side on medium and wider screens.
accessibility: Use <dl>, <dt>, and <dd> elements for semantic key–value structure that screen readers announce correctly.
Ensure sufficient color contrast between label text, value text, and background in both light and dark themes.
Do not rely on row background color alone to communicate grouping — use dividers or borders as well.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Plain key–value list with subtle row separators for clean record detail displays.
accessibility: Use <dl>/<dt>/<dd> markup for correct screen-reader announcement of key–value pairs.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Plain key–value list adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Label and value text colors must maintain WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Striped
variants.description: Key–value list with alternating row backgrounds to aid scannability in longer detail panels.
accessibility: Row stripe color is supplementary — do not use it as the only way to group related rows.

variants.title: Striped (Dark)
variants.description: Alternating-row key–value list adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark stripe backgrounds must contrast sufficiently with both label and value text.

variants.title: Bordered
variants.description: Key–value list enclosed in a visible outer border and with inner row borders for a structured card-like appearance.
accessibility: Borders are decorative; semantic structure still relies on <dl>/<dt>/<dd> elements.

variants.title: Bordered (Dark)
variants.description: Bordered key–value card adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark border colors must provide clear visual separation without dominating the content.

variants.title: Striped and bordered
variants.description: Key–value list combining alternating row stripes with an outer border for maximum structural clarity.
accessibility: Stripes and borders are supplementary visual aids; semantic structure is provided by <dl>/<dt>/<dd>.

variants.title: Striped and bordered (Dark)
variants.description: Striped-and-bordered key–value list adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Both stripe and border colors must remain readable against dark surface backgrounds.
